responsibility: Implements GCC’s global RTL GCSE subsystem, centered on partial redundancy elimination and code hoisting, together with related load/store-motion support and cost heuristics for deciding when the optimization is too expensive. It analyzes candidate set expressions and REG_EQUAL forms across the CFG, uses lazy code motion dataflow to place computations, updates reaching-register information for load/store motion, coordinates cleanup and rerun-CSE flags after transformations, and defines the separate PRE and hoist RTL passes and their gates.
same_name_distinction: Implements the main RTL GCSE subsystem referenced by gcc/gcse.h. Unlike the header’s small shared interface and target state, this source file contains the PRE and hoisting machinery, load/store motion support, cost gating logic, pass gates/execution, and module finalization for the actual global RTL optimization passes.
